# Know Your Meme

> > The comprehensive encyclopedia of internet culture, viral memes, and social media trends.

Know Your Meme documents and explains viral phenomena across platforms like TikTok, Twitter/X, Reddit, and YouTube. The site provides detailed guides on meme origins, cultural context, and spread patterns, serving as the authoritative source for understanding internet culture and digital communication trends.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Viral meme explanations
- Internet slang and catchphrases
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook)
- Meme creators and influencers
- Pop culture references
- Dance and music memes
- Nostalgia and generational humor
- Conspiracy theories and debunking
- Mental health memes
- Hood culture and 90s references
- Looksmaxxing and internet subcultures

## TikTok & Social Media Trends

- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok trend based on BunnaB/YKNiece song with swimming hand gesture
- [Millennial Burger Place | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): TikTok trend mocking millennial burger restaurant cliches and aesthetics
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok
- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring girl lying in dirt, viral on TikTok/Twitter
